impacts.title: Scientific advance in probabilistic multi-sensor crop-water-state estimation
impacts.description: The project would establish a defensible probabilistic-fusion decision framework in an area the literature reports as underdeveloped: few works couple learned multimodal fusion directly with explicit probabilistic crop-water-state outputs and irrigation optimisation end-to-end. It targets the empty 'real-time decision support x PlanetScope' cell of the reviewed gap matrix.
impacts.expected_impact_alignment: MSCA-PF criterion 2.3 - scientific impact: advancing the state of the art beyond the immediate scope of the project.
indicators: Open-access publication(s) establishing the end-to-end probabilistic fusion-to-decision framework
Demonstrated honest uncertainty propagation from observation to decision (calibration evidence, RQ5: 90% prediction-interval coverage)
Novelty defended against the reviewed precedents (BME, copula, dynamic Bayesian networks, MF-FusionNet)
impacts.timeline: M12-M24 (publications from mid-project; contingent on the validation protocol)
impacts.note: Inferred: the underlying gap facts are source_grounded (Research Gap Matrix METH-SOTA-007, Operational Decision Support Gap METH-SOTA-005), but the impact as stated rests on the novelty framing (Probabilistic Fusion Novelty Claim METH-SOTA-006), which is vault synthesis. IMP-2 and IMP-3 are Confirmed - their source nodes are wholly source_grounded and the resolved decisions are operator-confirmed.

impacts.title: Economic and societal impact: water-use efficiency and farm resilience
impacts.description: By recommending irrigation decisions that optimise water-use efficiency under uncertainty (RQ6) rather than yield alone, the framework targets improved water-use efficiency and economic resilience for tomato and row-crop horticulture - moving from a monitoring dashboard to a decision-support tool.
impacts.expected_impact_alignment: MSCA-PF criterion 2.3 - economic/societal impact: contribution to sustainable water use and agricultural decision-making.
indicators: Irrigation recommendations scored by water-use efficiency (WUE) under uncertainty (RQ6)
Demonstrator exercised on the observation-to-decision pipeline with uncertainty-aware recommendations
Pilot success defined as the RQ5 uncertainty-calibration target met on the validation set (RQ7); delivered as a research prototype (TRL 3-4, RQ10)
impacts.note: The decision objective is water-use efficiency (RQ6); the vault's objective-function machinery is instantiated with WUE rather than profit.
impacts.provenance_detail: source_grounded (decision machinery) + operator_confirmed (RQ6 = WUE; RQ7; RQ10)

impacts.title: Environmental co-benefit through landscape-compatible sensing
impacts.description: Route B's reliance on nearby homogeneous, semi-natural covarying patches aligns the methodology with landscape sustainability and extensive agriculture: keeping natural/semi-natural patches in the landscape is a co-benefit of the sensing approach, and the same proxy trick can scale beyond tomato horticulture.
impacts.expected_impact_alignment: MSCA-PF criterion 2.3 - societal/environmental impact: ecosystem continuity and sustainable land use.
indicators: Route B validated as a landscape-compatible sensing strategy (covariation test, RQ9)
Ecological co-benefit articulated as part of the methodology's strategic upside
impacts.note: The ecological co-benefit is source_grounded in methodology_idea.txt; the 'could turn out even better than Route A' claim is flagged inference in the vault and is NOT lifted as an impact.
